disclaimer: Synthetic, illustrative defect inventory for a personal portfolio project. Not real defects; contains no real company or production information.

defects.description: Beneficiary display name accepts input far longer than the supported length without rejection, leading to inconsistent storage and truncated display.
Submitting the add-beneficiary form twice in quick succession could create duplicate beneficiary entries. Fixed by de-duplicating on account identifier.
Double-clicking the confirm button could submit a transfer twice, producing a duplicate debit. Fixed with an idempotency key on transfer submission.
Step-up authentication is not re-challenged when adding a beneficiary during an already-elevated session, so a beneficiary can be added without a fresh one-time code.
The error returned when requesting another customer's beneficiary differs for existing versus non-existing identifiers, allowing beneficiary-identifier existence to be inferred.
